Risk_Description: Unmanaged assets may remain unidentified
Treatment: Implement automated asset discovery

Risk_Description: Outdated inventory may delay incident response
Treatment: Establish quarterly inventory reviews

Risk_Description: Retired assets may expose sensitive data
Treatment: Implement secure asset disposal process

Risk_Description: Inconsistent security practices may expose sensitive information
Threat: Human error and inconsistent security decisions
Treatment: Develop and communicate an approved security policy

Risk_Description: Outdated security requirements may result in ineffective controls
Treatment: Establish periodic and change-triggered policy reviews

Risk_Description: Excessive access permissions may enable unauthorized access to sensitive resources
Treatment: Review permissions and enforce least-privilege access

Risk_Description: Unnecessary user access may persist without periodic access reviews
Treatment: Establish quarterly access certification reviews

Risk_Description: Former employee accounts may remain active and enable unauthorized access
Threat: Misuse of accounts after employee termination
Treatment: Implement formal offboarding and timely account deactivation

Risk_Description: Dormant accounts may remain available for unauthorized access
Treatment: Implement recurring dormant account identification and review

Risk_Description: Insecure credential distribution or storage may expose authentication secrets
Weakness: Incomplete secure credential distribution and storage procedures
Treatment: Establish secure credential distribution and approved secrets management

Risk_Description: Compromised credentials may remain valid and enable continued unauthorized access
Weakness: No formal compromised credential revocation procedure
Treatment: Implement rapid credential revocation and replacement procedures

Risk_Description: Unclear incident response responsibilities may delay threat containment
Threat: Ransomware propagation and prolonged attacker activity
Weakness: No approved incident response plan and incomplete escalation procedures
Treatment: Develop and approve incident response plan with defined responsibilities

Risk_Description: Untested incident response procedures may result in ineffective containment and recovery
Treatment: Conduct incident response tabletop exercises and document lessons learned

Risk_Description: Privileged accounts without MFA may be compromised through stolen passwords
Threat: Credential theft and privileged account takeover
Weakness: Incomplete MFA enforcement for privileged accounts
Treatment: Enforce phishing-resistant MFA for privileged accounts

Risk_Description: Incomplete authentication monitoring may delay detection of suspicious sign-in activity
Weakness: Insufficient authentication event monitoring and alerting
Treatment: Implement authentication monitoring and suspicious sign-in alerts

Risk_Description: Insecure system configurations may expose sensitive cloud resources
Treatment: Establish approved secure configuration baselines

Risk_Description: Undetected configuration drift may weaken security controls
Threat: Security control bypass through unintended changes
Treatment: Implement configuration drift monitoring and periodic reviews

Risk_Description: Inadequately protected backups may be compromised or destroyed during a security incident
Threat: Ransomware encryption or deletion of backup data
Weakness: Incomplete backup immutability and protection controls
Treatment: Implement protected and immutable backup storage

Risk_Description: Untested backup restoration procedures may cause prolonged business disruption
Weakness: No regular documented backup restoration testing
Treatment: Establish recurring backup restoration testing

Risk_Description: Incomplete centralized logging may delay detection and investigation of security incidents
Weakness: Incomplete centralized security log collection and review
Treatment: Centralize security logs and establish monitoring procedures

Risk_Description: Insufficient log retention and integrity protection may undermine security investigations
Threat: Loss or manipulation of security evidence
Weakness: Incomplete log retention and integrity protection requirements
Treatment: Define log retention requirements and implement integrity protection
